disc: PAL SLES-52568 (the development image, a modified PAL image; on it the English text is the `Spanish` Code bank). Every mod and patch is made at run time from the disc and deleted afterwards; every game run deterministic headless (--deterministic --no-sdl-input --no-audio --skip-movies --trace-state --config none, an empty --mc-dir)

iso.why: the text-bank fixture changes 15 bytes of CRASH6/CRASH.BD; composed into a copy of the disc and imported back (as the image, then as xdelta3 -S none, PPF 3.0 and BPS patches of the image pair), the mod must touch exactly the fixture's files, compose them to the same sha256 (the tool's verify through the game's overlay, and the judge's own recomposition), and stay under 1 MB (a recipe, not a copy of the 930 MB archive)

crate.why: a Mod Crate folder: layer0/SYSTEM.CNF (one byte), layer1/<the fixture's bank> (the changed line), layer1/Mods/ImportJudge/added.bin (64 KB: the archive grows past its 1,975 spare bytes, so CRASH6/CRASH.BD moves to the virtual region). Imported: the index gains one entry, every entry recomposes to the crate's or the disc's bytes, SYSTEM.CNF is the crate's; on the OPTIONS route the game draws 'graphic optionz' (>= min_draws) and never 'graphic options', the census row counts 1 layer and 3 files (SYSTEM.CNF, CRASH.BH, CRASH.BD) with reads served, and the boot log shows the archive moved to the virtual region

exe.why: a folder holding the disc's SLES_525.68 with 8 bytes XORed inside FUN_001ac8d0 (Font::ConstructBase, from 0x001AC8D0) and the first 4 letters of the .rodata string 'internal alignment error' (the retail MPEG decoder's message; the port decodes the movies itself) upper-cased: code_changes exactly [that function], data_changes {.data 0, .rodata 4, .sdata 0, vu 0}, code_changes_unsupported; on, the overlay serves the program whole and the game reaches the Title (boundary ~1262 on this route)

base.why: the (iv) mod copied with its CRASH6/CRASH.BD row's base record edited: base_sample_sha256 zeroed (the start-up check), base_sha256 wrong with no sample (the whole-file check), base_bytes + 1 (the size check). Each must be refused at start-up with the line 'mods: the disc overlay left out <id>: disc/CRASH6/CRASH.BD.ranges: made for another CRASH6/CRASH.BD ...', the census row 0 layers, the original line drawn as often as in the vanilla run and the changed one never, and the pictures, sound and states byte-identical to the vanilla run

loose.why: : the disc's own Startup\Default.rm2 (the startup chunk), extracted at run time with 4 bytes cut from its end -- the sample loose Default.rm2 is a PAL chunk 4 bytes shorter than this disc's entry; never the original file -- dropped as ONE bare file: matched by its last name to the one entry of that name, the archive rebuilt as a crate's layer1 (the index rewritten, every later entry 4 bytes earlier, the archive a recipe), verify and this judge's recomposition (that entry the cut bytes, every other the disc's); a bare English.txt (several entries of that name on this disc) refused with them listed; over the North American disc (--ntsc-iso) the same file refused as the European disc's entry
